company: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG

source.label: Annual and Sustainability Report 2025, consolidated financial statements, consolidated statement of cash flows
Annual and Sustainability Report 2025, notes to the consolidated financial statements, note 2 Cost of sales
source.quote: In the fiscal year 2025, research and development costs in the Porsche AG Group recognized through profit or loss amounted to €3,146 million (2024: €2,033 million).

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. R&D: the amount recognised through profit or loss (€3,146m), which includes amortisation and impairment of capitalised development costs and excludes the €963m capitalised in 2025, so it is not total R&D spend; it rose from €2,033m mainly on impairments tied to the product-strategy realignment (automotive amortisation of capitalised development costs €1,830m vs €1,101m). Taxes: income taxes paid in operating cash flow (€317m).
